tenant.title: Which PlayHQ tenant?
tenant.description: {sport} on PlayHQ is run by separate state or national bodies, each its own PlayHQ tenant - it's the first part of the URL on any of that body's PlayHQ pages, e.g. 'basketball-victoria' in playhq.com/basketball-victoria/org/..., or 'cricket-australia' in playhq.com/cricket-australia/org/...

track_player.title: Track a player
track_player.description: PlayHQ has no public player search, so enter their profile ID directly - it's the UUID in a public PlayHQ player-profile page URL.
